elements.element: Contractor must maintain commercial general liability insurance with limits of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence.
elements.evidence: The clause requires comprehensive general liability coverage of at least USD 1,000,000 but does not state that this limit applies per occurrence.

elements.element: Contractor must maintain commercial general liability insurance with an aggregate limit of at least USD 2,000,000.
Contractor must maintain professional errors and omissions insurance with limits of at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: The clause requires professional errors and omissions insurance of only USD 1,000,000.

elements.element: Where Contractor processes Company Data, Contractor must maintain cyber/privacy insurance with limits of at least USD 5,000,000.
elements.evidence: The added sentence applies where Contractor processes Company data but requires only USD 2,000,000 of cyber liability insurance and does not expressly include privacy liability coverage.

elements.element: Contractor must maintain workers' compensation insurance in the amount required by law.
elements.evidence: The clause requires workers compensation insurance in the amount required by statute.

elements.element: Contractor must provide certificates of insurance upon Company's request.
elements.evidence: At Company's request, Contractor must provide certificates or other acceptable evidence of insurance or self-insurance.

elements.element: Contractor must maintain professional errors and omissions insurance with limits of at least USD 1,000,000.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly requires professional errors and omissions insurance with coverage of at least USD 1,000,000.

elements.element: Where Contractor processes Company Data, Contractor must maintain cyber insurance with limits of at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: The added operative sentence requires cyber liability insurance of at least USD 2,000,000 where Contractor processes Company data.

result.reason: The redline minimally adds the cyber coverage needed to reach the fallback while retaining the existing USD 1,000,000 E&O coverage. It does not reach the preferred position because the general liability limits are not identified as USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 aggregate, E&O remains at USD 1,000,000, and cyber coverage remains at USD 2,000,000 without express privacy coverage.
